data.body: **P2 — Make wrapper inspection failure-safe.** This unbounded loop calls `getCause()` twice. A scope callback can throw a `CompletionException`/`ExecutionException` subclass whose accessor throws or cycles, causing that secondary nonfatal error to replace the handler outcome and abort remaining reverse-order cleanup. Read each cause once with identity-based cycle detection, guard accessor failures, and continue cleanup unless the observed failure is VM-fatal or `ThreadDeath`; add throwing- and cyclic-accessor tests.
